title: Kaju Katli
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Kaju (Cashew nuts) 250g (1 & ½ Cup) soaked for 2 hours
steps.romanUrdu: -Kaju (Cashew nuts) 250g (1 & ½ Cup) soaked for 2 hours

steps.instruction: -In a grinder,add sugar & grind to make a powder and take out in a frying pan.
steps.romanUrdu: -Grinder mein cheeni dal dein aur grind ker ka powder tayyar ker lein & frying pan mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: -In a grinder,add soaked cashew nuts,gradually add water & grind to make a thick paste & take out in a same frying pan.
steps.romanUrdu: -Grinder mein soaked kaju aur thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur grind ker ka thick paste tayyar ker lein & frying pan mein nikal lein.

steps.instruction: -Add milk powder & mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: -Milk powder dal dein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Turn on the flame & cook on low flame until soft dough is formed (20-30 minutes) & mix continuously.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chulha on karein aur halki ancch per soft dough form ho janay tak paka lein (20-30 minutes) & musalsal chamcha chalatay rahein.

steps.instruction: -Add desi ghee,mix well & cook on low flame for 4-5 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Dei ghee dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur halki ancch per 4-5 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: -On greased baking tray,add & spread kaju mixture evenly.
steps.romanUrdu: -Greased baking tray per kaju mixture dal ker evenly pheela lein.

steps.instruction: -Grease rolling pin with oil & roll out with the help of rolling pin.
steps.romanUrdu: -Rolling pin ko oil sa grease karein aur rolling pin ki madad sa bail lein.

steps.instruction: -Apply edible silver leaves & press with muslin cloth.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chandi warq laga lein aur malmal ka kapray sa press ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Cut into diamond shape & let it set for 3-4 hours at room temperature & serve
steps.romanUrdu: -Diamond shape mein cut ker lein aur 3-4 hours kliya room temperature per set hunay kliya chor dein & serve karein!

ogDescription: Aside from being delicious, this 3 ingredients Kaju Katli is very simple to make and can be ready in minutes. Try this delightful sweet made with Olper’s
